description_en: Retrieves a list of workflow instances
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx3 list-workflow-executions --cluster-id xxljob-b6ec1xxxx --app-name test-app --workflow-id 20 --workflow-name myWorkflow --workflow-execution-id 100 --status 4 --start-time 2025-10-27_02:15:00 --end-time 2025-10-13_16:00:00 --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --max-results 10 --next-token eCKqVlS5FKF5EWGGOo8EgQ== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListWorkflowExecutions

parameters.help_en:
The workflow execution status. Use this parameter to filter executions by status. Valid values:

- 0: unknown

- 1: waiting

- 2: queued

- 3: running

- 4: success

- 5: failed

- 6: killed

- 7: held

- 8: mark\_success

- 9: skipped
